tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(daemontest): capture FakeSpawner's mcp-config and system-prompt files

FakeSpawnerCall now records the bytes of the mcp-config and system-prompt
files at the moment Run is called -- the only window in which they exist,
since ClaudeRunner.Run removes both via deferred os.Remove after Run
returns. Needed by the beadle-p43a and beadle-vr0v regression tests to
assert on what a worker actually receives.
EOF
)"
